scope: Engineering findings, subordinate to existing project authority; not a replacement project checklist.

findings.location: Storage-gate wing crossed the drive-side captive guide in mid-stroke.
findings.correction: Outboard wing/crossbolt, lower blocker and local cassette bridge.

findings.location: Closed fork crossmember crossed the original tall receiver during return; raising it created new crossings.
findings.correction: FM-02 uses a12mm underfloor receiver; original closed fork retained.

findings.location: Underfloor latch arms crossed a support web during opening.
findings.correction: Slot the base at moving arms; route guide webs outside their Xbands.

findings.location: Sled capture bar crossed cassette ends during captive80mm travel.
findings.correction: Eight-millimetre receiver-port relief leaves4mm nominal Ygap.

findings.location: Power loss could move an unlatched receiver into a straddling payload.
findings.correction: Two3mm crosspins form-lock each endpoint; explicit unlock/move/lock phases.

findings.location: Shared false receiver confirmation can defeat Boolean guards.
findings.correction: Two-confirmation software model; physically inserted pins checked separately.

findings.location: BXR-LE source manual prohibits its use for moving-load braking.
findings.correction: Reject that dynamic application; examine BXW-L as a separate candidate.

findings.location: Custom screw/nut high-speed rating was unestablished at2/5/10s.
findings.correction: Retain ACT-01 failure domain; assess integrated32L ball-screw separately.

findings.location: Small functional gaps do not absorb declared manufacturing/alignment bands.
findings.correction: Publish the115nonpositive residuals; define actual datums,bores and fits before release.

findings.location: Repeated feed/return heating can exceed winding ceiling.
Slow auxiliaries exceed later twelve-release coast intervals.
findings.correction: Compare103.0s and74.5s cycle assumptions against92.182s available coasts.

findings.location: Comparable installed seven-candidate and four/twelve-cell hardware boundary incomplete.
findings.correction: Retain all alternatives and evidence-gated unselected disposition.
